quick_skim.title: MX-Like Tensor Core for LLM Inference with NPU Integration via Hardware-Software Co-Design Exploration
quick_skim.abstract: Block-scaled quantization formats such as OCP Microscaling (MX) and NVFP4 have been widely adopted as efficient data formats for LLM inference. However, the design space of these formats spanned by shared scale, weight, and activation format combinations has not been systematically explored, and the joint accuracy-silicon tradeoff across this space remains uncharacterized, leaving the true Pareto-optimal configurations for NPU-based edge LLM deployment an open question. To bridge this gap, we conduct a joint hardware-software (HW-SW) co-design exploration of the above underexplored MX-like design space with three innovations. 1) We define and systematically characterize the full 8-bit scale format family within the MX-like design space, jointly with asymmetric weight-activation precision, identifying configurations that outperform the MX and NVFP4-like (without per-tensor scaling, PTS) baselines. 2) We build a per-format specialized MAC datapath template that enables fair hardware cost evaluation across the space. 3) We develop an automated co-design flow, integrated into the open-source SNAX NPU platform, that enables joint HW-SW analysis across the design space. Overall, our co-design exploration reveals that scale format matters only under aggressive FP4 quantization, yielding a case-oriented design guideline for both scale format and asymmetric weight-activation precision. We further identify UE5M3 as a favorable accuracy-hardware tradeoff for the FP4 regime, reducing perplexity degradation by up to 25.3% relative to the NVFP4-like baseline, at a cost of only +0.06% area and +0.49% power overhead.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对OCP Microscaling与NVFP4等块缩放量化格式在共享尺度、权重与激活组合上的设计空间缺乏系统探索、精度与芯片代价的权衡尚不清晰的问题，论文开展软硬件协同设计探索，定义了完整8位尺度格式族并系统刻画其精度与硅面积、能耗的关系。研究给出面向NPU边缘部署的帕累托最优配置，并配套张量核设计。该工作为LLM低比特量化推理的格式选择与硬件实现提供实证依据。

quick_skim.title: CondenseVLA: Learnable History Condensation for Efficient Multi-Frame VLA
quick_skim.abstract: Robot manipulation often depends on short-term cues - such as brief contacts, temporary occlusions, and intermediate object states - that are ambiguous in a single frame and can only be resolved by integrating observations over time. However, injecting historical information solely by enlarging the history window is computationally costly and frequently yields limited gains due to substantial redundancy and task-agnostic, inflexible sampling of observations. We propose CondenseVLA, a multi-frame VLA policy with a learnable decoder-side history condensation module for using short-term visual context in action decoding. Given a sequence of cached per-frame features from the VLM backbone, CondenseVLA distills observation history into a fixed set of slot tokens using learnable queries and multi-head cross-attention. Simple auxiliary regularization penalizes overlap among slot attention maps and decorrelates slot embeddings, encouraging complementary attention and reducing slot redundancy. Across the evaluated tasks, CondenseVLA improves Simpler-WidowX success from 58.7% to 69.8% (+11.1 percentage points), achieves 97.2% on LIBERO, and reaches 52.8% on real-world tasks. It achieves 21.6% success on memory-dependent RMBench tasks. These results support selective condensation of bounded recent visual evidence for action decoding, while harder multi-observation tasks expose the limits of a finite history window. Project page: https://github.com/FeiyangHong/CondenseVLA

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Multi-frame VLA policies need history to resolve short-term ambiguity, but enlarging the history window is costly and redundant. CondenseVLA adds a learnable decoder-side history condensation module that distills cached per-frame VLM features into a fixed set of compact slots for action decoding, preserving temporal context efficiently.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 机器人操作依赖短暂接触、遮挡等时序线索，单帧难以消解，但直接扩大历史窗口代价高且冗余严重。论文提出CondenseVLA，在解码器侧引入可学习的历史凝聚模块，把缓存的多帧视觉特征蒸馏为固定数量的紧凑槽位，供动作解码使用。实验表明该方法在保持多帧视觉上下文理解能力的同时显著降低推理开销，为高效压缩时序视觉token并保留时间信息提供了可迁移思路。
